content.tex: INVESTIGATION PATHS AROUND SQUARES AND RECTANGLES
This investigation looks at paths around different squares and rectangles.
In this investigation \(\bullet\) all lengths are in metres \(\bullet\) all tiles are squares of side 1 metre.
The path around a square of side 1 needs 8 square tiles.
This is the path around a square of side 2.
